name: Nalu Vida
facts: Nalu Vida is at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier.
Phone: (310) 437-0060. Email: info@naluvida.com. Instagram: @naluvidavenice.
Hours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–12 AM, Fri 10 AM–2 AM, Sat 9 AM–2 AM, Sun 9 AM–12 AM.
Brunch runs daily until 4 PM, with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 min).
Happy hour is Mon–Fri 3–6 PM and 10 PM–close, dine-in only.
Parking: the public beach lot next to the pier, plus street parking.
Book a table on Resy. 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.
Private events: parties of 10 to 100. The tour is free and so is your drink.
Joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free. One account per person.
You earn 10 points per $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.
Joining gives +100 points. Your birthday gives +250 once a year.
A friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit earns you +100.
The game gives 1 point per 100 score, up to 50 game points a day.
Rewards: 250 pts, 500 pts, 1,000 pts ($20 off your check) and 1,500 pts (free entrée up to $33).
Tap Use reward to open a live pass. It works once and expires after 10 minutes.
One reward per member per day, and one prize per day.
Rewards are never free alcohol.
Nalu Vida points are separate from Melody Bar & Grill points.
Ride the Nalu is a free surf game with 5 levels. No sign-up is needed to play.
The weekly game board is for bragging rights only and resets every Monday.
Burger Mondays, Taco Tuesday, Shuckin' Good Wednesday and NFL Sunday are the weekly specials.
Events: Mon trivia, Tue acoustic, Thu live jazz, Fri karaoke, plus game-day TVs.
You can order from your phone by picking Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop.
Menu prices are shown in the app. MP means market price, so ask your server.
The language menu offers English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai and Russian.
Your digital rewards card has a QR code and an NLV card ID.
suggested: How do I play Ride the Nalu?

qa.q: What are your hours?
qa.a: Mon–Thu 11 AM–12 AM, Fri 10 AM–2 AM, Sat 9 AM–2 AM, and Sun 9 AM–12 AM. Brunch is served daily until 4 PM.

qa.q: Are you open right now?
qa.a: The top of the app shows if we're open now and when we close or open next. You can also call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What time do you open on weekends?
qa.a: Saturday and Sunday we open at 9 AM. Saturday closes at 2 AM and Sunday at 12 AM.

qa.q: What time do you close?
qa.a: Mon–Thu and Sun we close at 12 AM (midnight). Fri and Sat we close at 2 AM.

qa.q: Are you open late?
qa.a: Yes. Friday and Saturday we're open until 2 AM, and the other nights until midnight.

qa.q: Where are you located?
qa.a: We're at 1 Washington Blvd, Venice, CA 90292, at the foot of the Venice Pier. Tap Directions in the app for a map.

qa.q: What's your phone number?
What's your email?
qa.a: You can email info@naluvida.com.

qa.q: Where do I park?
qa.a: There's a public beach lot right next to the pier, plus street parking.

qa.q: Do you have outdoor seating?
qa.a: Yes. We have a heated patio steps from the sand, and the app lists Patio, Bar, Dining room and Rooftop as seating areas.

qa.q: Can I make a reservation?
qa.a: Yes. Tap Book on Resy in the app to reserve a table.

qa.q: Is there a gratuity for big groups?
qa.a: A 20% gratuity is added for parties of 6 or more.

qa.q: Do you host private events?
qa.a: Yes, for parties of 10 to 100 people. Come see the space: the tour is free and so is your drink. Tap Plan an event in the app or email info@naluvida.com.

qa.q: Is there a happy hour?
qa.a: Yes. Happy hour is Mon–Fri 3–6 PM and 10 PM–close, dine-in only.

qa.q: What's on happy hour?
qa.a: $10 house margarita, wells, house red & white and Prosecco, plus $2 off drafts. Food: Smash-N-Stack $15, Vegan Burger $16, Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice $16, Tostadas $14, Hula Wings (6) $14, South American Caesar $15, Buffalo Chicken Strips $10, Fries $5 and Sweet Potato Fries $6.

qa.q: Is happy hour on weekends?
qa.a: No. Happy hour is Monday through Friday only, and dine-in only.

qa.q: Is happy hour available for takeout?
qa.a: No, happy hour is dine-in only.

qa.q: What are today's specials?
qa.a: The app's Today at Nalu Vida section shows the special for the day. Weekly: Burger Mondays, Taco Tuesday, Shuckin' Good Wednesday and NFL Sunday, plus daily brunch.

qa.q: What is Burger Monday?
qa.a: Mondays have $9 burgers and a $5 draft beer special, 5 PM to close.

qa.q: What is Taco Tuesday?
qa.a: Tuesdays are 50% off signature tacos all day, plus $10 house margaritas.

qa.q: What's the Wednesday special?
qa.a: Shuckin' Good Wednesday: $2 oysters (minimum 6), while supplies last.

qa.q: What happens on Sundays?
qa.a: NFL Sunday: every NFL game is on the TVs, and bottomless mimosas are on.

qa.q: Do you have bottomless mimosas?
qa.a: Yes. Brunch is daily until 4 PM with $24 bottomless mimosas (60 minutes).

qa.q: When is brunch?
qa.a: Brunch is served daily until 4 PM.

qa.q: What's on the brunch menu?
qa.a: Huevos con Gallo Pinto $19, Avocado Toast $14, French Toast $18, Breakfast Burrito $18, Steak & Eggs $29 and Breakfast Burger $15.

qa.q: What events do you have this week?
qa.a: The Events this week section of the app shows each day. Typical lineup: Mon trivia and football, Tue acoustic, Thu live jazz and football, Fri karaoke, Sun NFL.

qa.q: When is trivia night?
qa.a: Trivia is Mondays 7–9 PM, with Monday Night Football on.

qa.q: When is live music?
qa.a: Acoustic Tuesday is 8–11 PM and live jazz is Thursday 6–9 PM. Live blues is on the 4th Saturday, 3–6 PM.

qa.q: When is karaoke?
qa.a: Karaoke is Fridays from 9 PM to close.

qa.q: Do you have a block party or salsa night?
qa.a: The 2nd Saturday of the month is our Block Party, and we also host salsa nights. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060 for the next salsa date.

qa.q: Can I watch sports here?
qa.a: Yes. Every game is on the TVs, and the app has live scores in Game Day at the Pier.

qa.q: Do you show Thursday and Monday Night Football?
qa.a: Yes, Monday Night Football and Thursday Night Football are on, and every NFL game on Sunday.

qa.q: Where can I see live scores?
qa.a: Tap Live scores in the app. It shows scores for LA teams and games from several leagues, and you can follow your teams.

qa.q: What is Nalu Vida Rewards?
qa.a: It's our free points program. You earn points when you spend or play the game, then trade them for food and drinks.

qa.q: How do I join the rewards program?
qa.a: Joining is free. Use the rewards card in the app and sign up. You get 100 points when you join.

qa.q: Is it free to join?
qa.a: Yes, joining Nalu Vida Rewards is free. It's one account per person.

qa.q: How many points do I get per dollar?
qa.a: You earn 10 points for every $1 on eligible purchases, before tip.

qa.q: How do I earn points on my meal?
qa.a: In the app, tap Add my visit. Snap your receipt or type the check number, total and date (today or yesterday).

qa.q: What are the limits on Add my visit?
qa.a: One receipt per member per day, each check can be used once, and up to $150 per check counts.

qa.q: Do points get checked?
qa.a: Yes. Claims are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and points from made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Do I earn points on tip?
qa.a: No. Points are 10 per $1 before tip.

qa.q: How many points do I get for joining?
qa.a: You get 100 points once, when you join.

qa.q: Is there a birthday reward?
qa.a: Yes. You get 250 bonus points once a year on your birthday.

qa.q: Do you have a referral program?
qa.a: Yes. You get 100 points for each friend who joins with your code and makes a first visit.

qa.q: How does the friend code work?
qa.a: You can enter one friend's code, once, when you join. It can't be changed later and you can't use your own.

qa.q: Can I stack a referral with another reward?
qa.a: No. A referral never stacks with another reward on the same visit.

qa.q: What can I get with points?
qa.a: 250 pts: free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries. 500 pts: a free shareable (Chips, Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs). 1,000 pts: $20 off your check. 1,500 pts: a free entrée up to $33.

qa.q: What does the 250-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free mocktail, soft drink or Jungle Fries.

qa.q: What does the 500-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free shareable: Chips Salsa & Guac, Calamari, Wings or Sticky Tiki Ribs.

qa.q: What does the 1,000-point reward get me?
qa.a: $20 off your check.

qa.q: What does the 1,500-point reward get me?
qa.a: A free entrée up to $33: Steak & Fries, Tiki Ribs, Blackened Salmon, Seared Ahi, Chicken Milanese, Scampi Skewers, Adobo Chicken or Fish N' Chips.

qa.q: How do I redeem a reward?
qa.a: Tap Use reward and confirm. A live pass opens, and you show it to your server, who applies it.

qa.q: When do points come off?
qa.a: The points come off when you open the pass.

qa.q: How long does my reward pass last?
qa.a: The pass works once and expires 10 minutes after it opens. Open it when you're ready to order or pay.

qa.q: Can I use more than one reward in a day?
qa.a: No. It's one reward per member per day, and one prize per day. A second one shows Come back tomorrow.

qa.q: Can I get a free alcoholic drink with points?
qa.a: No. Rewards are never free alcohol.

qa.q: Can I give my reward to someone else?
qa.a: No. Rewards have no cash value and can't be transferred.

qa.q: Do points expire?
qa.a: We don't have an expiry rule listed. Points you've earned stay in your balance unless the program ends. Ask staff if you have questions.

qa.q: Are there levels or tiers?
qa.a: No. There's one simple points balance and one rewards ladder, with no levels or VIP tiers.

qa.q: Is there a spin wheel or daily draw?
qa.a: No. There's no daily spin, prize wheel, lucky draw or tokens. Just points.

qa.q: Can I use my Melody Bar & Grill points here?
qa.a: No. Each spot has its own points balance, and points don't move between restaurants.

qa.q: Is there a bonus for arriving early or checking in?
qa.a: We don't have an early-bird or location bonus listed for Nalu Vida. Ask staff or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: What is the digital rewards card?
qa.a: It's a member card in the app with your name, card ID, points balance, next reward and a QR code. Tap My Rewards Card to open it.

qa.q: Can I add the card to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet?
qa.a: Wallet buttons aren't turned on yet. You can add the app to your Home Screen to keep your card one tap away.

qa.q: How do I add the app to my phone?
qa.a: On iPhone, tap Share then Add to Home Screen then Add. On Android, tap the menu then Add to Home screen or Install app.

qa.q: What is Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: It's our free surf game on the Venice Pier loop. You paddle out, grab food rafts and ride the wave home across 5 levels.

qa.q: Do I need an account to play?
qa.a: No. It's free to play with or without an account, and no purchase is needed.

qa.q: How do I play Ride the Nalu?
qa.a: Drag left and right to steer. Paddling out, tap Duck Dive (or the screen) as each breaking wave reaches you. Riding in, stay off the white foam and tap Jump to launch off the lip.

qa.q: What are the game controls?
qa.a: Drag to steer. Tap Duck Dive or Jump under waves, or swipe up to launch. In the air, tap Trick or swipe: sideways for a 360, down for a grab, up for a flip.

qa.q: How does scoring work in the game?
qa.a: You score from grabbing food rafts (Island Tacos +100, Mimosa +120, Jungle Fries +120, Smash-N-Stack +150, Coconut Shrimp +150), duck-diving (+100), barrel exits (+200) and tricks. Streaks multiply your points.

qa.q: What hurts me in the game?
qa.a: You have 5 hearts, lost in halves. White foam costs −½ heart and −100, stingrays and stray harpoons cost a heart, and a mid-trick landing costs −150. A wipeout is just a splash.

qa.q: How long is a game?
qa.a: Level 1 takes about 2 minutes. Later levels have shorter paddle-outs.

qa.q: How many levels are there?
qa.a: There are 5 levels. Ride all 5 for a big finish bonus.

qa.q: How do game points turn into rewards points?
qa.a: Every 100 score is worth 1 Nalu Vida Rewards point, up to 50 game points a day.

qa.q: What's the daily limit on game points?
qa.a: You can earn up to 50 game points a day (Los Angeles date). You can still keep playing for fun after that.

qa.q: I played without joining. Do I lose my points?
qa.a: Your points from today are held on your phone. Join the same day to save them.

qa.q: How often can I play?
qa.a: As often as you like. Only the points are capped at 50 a day.

qa.q: Is there a weekly leaderboard?
qa.a: Yes. The weekly board is for bragging rights and resets every Monday. Last week's top 3 show on the champion card.

qa.q: Do I win a prize for being the weekly champion?
qa.a: No. The game gives no prizes, codes or discounts, and the weekly board is for bragging rights only.

qa.q: When does the weekly board close?
qa.a: The card in the app says this week's board closes Sunday 11:00 PM. The rules say it resets every Monday.

qa.q: Are cheats allowed in the game?
qa.a: No. Scores made with cheats, scripts, bots or multiple accounts don't count.

qa.q: Can I change the game's graphics, weather or music?
qa.a: Yes. In the game's settings you can pick Graphics, Weather and Time of day, a 3D graphics option, and a song (Cheat Code or Xtreme Rich Person). These don't change the gameplay.

qa.q: Can I play with a game controller?
qa.a: Yes. Controllers can work in most browsers. Press any button after connecting it, and Select or Share opens controller help.

qa.q: What's the billboard buoy in the game?
qa.a: A billboard buoy floats by the pier once a run. Ride through it for a +500 bonus and a link to Antidote The Foodie's review of Nalu Vida.

qa.q: Is there a kids mode?
qa.a: We don't have a kid mode listed. The game has no weapons or boss fights, and wipeouts are a mild splash.

qa.q: Can I order from my table?
qa.a: Yes. In the app, pick Patio, Bar, Dining room or Rooftop, add items and send your order. If you scanned a table code, your seat is already picked.

qa.q: How do I order at a table?
qa.a: Pick your spot, then tap a table number (Bar needs no number), add items and tap Send my order. Your server or bartender gets it.

qa.q: How do I pay?
qa.a: Pay your server or bartender like normal. Members earn points on what they spend.

qa.q: Does the QR code at my table pick my seat?
qa.a: Yes. A scanned table code is already picked, so your order goes to the right place.

qa.q: What's on the menu?
qa.a: Shareables, Signature Island Tacos, Breakwater Bites (burgers and more), Entrées, Pizza & Flatbreads, Pasta, Soup & Salad, Brunch, plus cocktails, mocktails, beer and coffee.

qa.q: What shareables do you have?
qa.a: Oysters (MP), Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice $22, Coconut Shrimp $21, Bang Bang Shrimp $18, Jungle Fries $12, Chips Salsa & Guac $14, Wings $17, Tostadas de la Tierra $18, 12-Hr Smoked Pork Sliders $19, Calamari $15 and Sticky Tiki Ribs $18.

qa.q: What tacos do you have?
qa.a: Tamarind Glazed Gulf Shrimp $18, Blackened Salmon $21, Vegan Chorizo $19, Baja Blaze Chicken $17 and Beer Battered Fish $20.

qa.q: What burgers and sandwiches do you have?
qa.a: Smash-N-Stack Burger $18, Vegan Burger $22, BBQ Smoke Wave $22, Chipotle Chicken Sandwich $20 and Cheesesteak $16. Poke Bowl $24 and Veggie Burrito $19 are under Breakwater Bites too.

qa.q: What entrées do you have?
qa.a: Blackened Salmon $32, Shrimp Scampi Skewers $31, Chili-Kissed Sesame Seared Ahi $32, Adobo Grilled Chicken $29, Crispy Chicken Milanese $30, Steak & Fries $33, Fish N' Chips $24 and Tiki Ribs $31.

qa.q: Do you have pizza or pasta?
qa.a: Yes. Flatbreads: Margherita $15, Pepperoni $16, Elote $17, In-N-Out Style $17 and BBQ Chicken $17. Pasta: Build-Your-Own Pasta $18.

qa.q: Do you have salads?
qa.a: Yes: Citrus Bomb Salad $15, South American Caesar $18 and Sesame Chicken Salad $21.

qa.q: Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?
qa.a: Yes. The menu includes the Vegan Burger, BBQ Smoke Wave, Vegan Chorizo Tacos, Veggie Burrito and Avocado Toast. Ask your server about ingredients.

qa.q: What cocktails do you have?
qa.a: Nalu Margarita $17, Makai $17, Frozen Cocoa De Rasta $18, Frozen Blackberry Luau $18, Pura Vida $18, Lost in Sayulita $19, Sunset Sour $20, Barrel-Aged Old Fashioned $19 and Pau Hana Punch $18.

qa.q: Do you have non-alcoholic drinks?
qa.a: Yes. Mocktails: Wish You Were Here $15 and Put the Lime in the Coconut $15. We also have Coco Cold Brew $11.

qa.q: Do you have beer?
qa.a: Yes, including Nalu Vida Blonde Ale at $9.50. Happy hour takes $2 off drafts.

qa.q: What does MP mean?
qa.a: MP means market price. Ask your server for today's price.

qa.q: Do you serve alcohol to everyone?
qa.a: No. Alcohol is 21+, and the app marks adult drinks.

qa.q: Can I change the app's language?
qa.a: Yes. Tap the 🌐 language button for English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Tagalog, Vietnamese, Armenian, Persian, Japanese, Thai or Russian. Restaurant and game names stay in English.

qa.q: What do you record when I open the app?
qa.a: The time, a short device summary, whether you opened it from your Home Screen, a random phone ID and your member ID if you joined. Approximate location is recorded only if you already turned it on for this app.

qa.q: Does the app track my location?
qa.a: The app never asks for location just for this. If you've turned location on, it records one approximate spot when you open the app, and nothing runs in the background.

qa.q: Do you sell my information?
qa.a: No. It's seen only by the restaurant's owner and SousShift AI, never sold and not used for ads.

qa.q: Do you have a sister restaurant?
qa.a: Yes, Melody Bar & Grill by LAX at 9132 S Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90045, (310) 670-1994. It has its own app, game and points balance.

qa.q: Where can I find you on social media?
qa.a: Instagram: @naluvidavenice. The app also shows our latest posts.

qa.q: How do I get help from staff?
qa.a: Ask your server or bartender, or call (310) 437-0060.

qa.q: My points look wrong. What should I do?
qa.a: Ask your server or call (310) 437-0060. Points are checked against the restaurant's sales report, and duplicates or made-up checks are removed.

qa.q: Are the menu photos final?
qa.a: The app notes that menu photos are previews until Nalu Vida signs off. Prices come from Nalu Vida's menu.
